dish.note: Griddled yoghurt flatbreads brushed with garlic and herb oil.
dish.how: Mix 400g self-raising flour, 400g Greek yoghurt and 1 tsp salt into a soft dough, knead 2 minutes and divide into 8. Roll each to 3mm and cook in a dry hot pan for 2 minutes a side until puffed and blistered. Brush with 4 tbsp olive oil warmed with 3 crushed garlic cloves and a handful of chopped parsley, and serve warm.

steps.text: Mix the flour, yoghurt and salt into a soft dough, knead briefly and divide into 8.
Cook in a dry hot pan, 2 minutes a side, until puffed and blistered.
Warm the oil with the garlic, stir in the parsley and brush over the breads.

dish.make_ahead: Cook up to 2 hours ahead and wrap in a tea towel; brush with oil just before serving
